description: This Xinjiang Agricultural University dataset contains 1,285 annotated rural-road images collected in northern Xinjiang during 2021–2023. A GoPro HERO9 camera captured asphalt, concrete, gravel and dirt roads in daylight and dusk. The researchers label 40 semantic classes, including 20 instance classes, with 10,062 instance objects. Vehicles, pedestrians, livestock, signs and other roadside objects provide examples for agricultural-machine perception. ScienceDB offers original images, matching masks and JSON annotations in archives, free under CC BY-SA 4.0. The selected frames are not a continuous traffic survey, and their rural coverage is limited and constrains transfer to other environments. They can test scene-recognition components used in simulated vehicle operations or digital representations of agricultural transport. No directly related catalogue record was found.
